description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jamal Adams was carted off the field during Saturday's preseason game against the Giants.
items.impact: It is another brutal break for Adams. There will be an update on his status when available.
items.title: Jamal Adams carted off field Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bryce Young will plan 10-15 snaps on Saturday with the starters.
items.impact: Young will likely play two series as a result. He is looking to take another step forward under center for the Panthers this season.
items.title: Bryce Young expected to see 10-15 snaps in preseason opener Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said RB Jeremiyah Love will be out this week as he deals with a sore ankle.
items.impact: LaFleur said the Cardinals will revisit Love's status after this week. There should be an update on his status by next weekend. Tyler Allgeier will figure to see the first-team reps in the meantime.
items.title: Jeremiyah Love to miss this week with ankle injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks and CB Devon Witherspoon agreed to a four-year, $132 million extension.
items.impact: The extension includes over $101 million guaranteed that now makes Witherspoon the highest-paid cornerback in NFL history. The three-time Pro-Bowl CB will once again lead one of the top defenses in the NFL this season.
items.title: Devon Witherspoon signs historic four-year extension with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Luther Burden III was able to get in some light work on the field prior to Saturday's preseason game against the Browns.
items.impact: Burden was able to sprint from the 40 to the end zone. He is continuing to slowly work his way back from a groin injury.
items.title: Luther Burden III (groin) gets in light work Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Max Iheanachor was still not practicing on Saturday.
items.impact: Iheanachor remains without a clear timetable to return to practice.
items.title: Max Iheanachor absent from practice Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Broncos LB Levelle Bailey suffered a serious leg injury in Friday night's preseason game and will miss extended time.
items.impact: It is a brutal break for Bailey, who had signed a futures deal with Denver back in January. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.
items.title: Levelle Bailey to miss extended time with leg injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Germie Bernard took first-team slot reps in practice on Saturday.
items.impact: Bernard impressed in his preseason debut with 51 yards on four receptions. DK Metcalf and Michael Pittman Jr. remained absent from practice on Saturday.
items.title: Germie Bernard works with first-team in practice Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. is still not practicing on Saturday.
items.impact: Pittman has been sidelined from practice due to an undisclosed injury. He is day-to-day for now.
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. absent from practice Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DK Metcalf remained absent from practice on Saturday.
items.impact: Metcalf has been sidelined from practice due to an undisclosed injury. He is day-to-day for now.
items.title: DK Metcalf still not practicing Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bengals activated DL B.J. Hill from the PUP list.
items.impact: Hill was placed on the PUP list in the last week of July. He has passed his physical and he's been cleared to return to practice.
items.title: B.J. Hill activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Saints are planning for QB Hunter Dekkers to get some opportunities in Saturday's preseason opener.
items.impact: Dekkers returned to the Saints in June. He is competing for a depth role in their quarterback room.
items.title: Hunter Dekkers to get reps in preseason opener Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: 49ers CB Nate Hobbs is expected to miss the next few weeks with a groin injury.
items.impact: Hobbs signed a one-year contract with the 49ers in March. His status for the start of the season could be up in the air.
items.title: Nate Hobbs (groin) to miss a few weeks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DeMarcus Lawrence has said he will retire after this season.
items.impact: Lawrence had considered retiring after last season. He is entering his 13th season.
items.title: DeMarcus Lawrence to retire after this season

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Terrell Burgess will not play in the Saints preseason opener on Saturday against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Burgess left practice early on Thursday with a lower body injury. He'll be hopeful to return to practice next week.
items.title: Terrell Burgess (lower body) will not play in preseason opener Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka has a sprained toe, but he is expected to be good to go for Week 1.
items.impact: Egbuka underwent more testing on his injured toe and a specialist diagnosed him with a sprained toe after he limped off the field during the joint practice at the Jets' facility.
items.title: Emeka Egbuka dealing with sprained toe, expected to be ready for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Josh Jacobs could return to practice next week.
items.impact: LaFleur clarified that it wouldn't be till later in the week. Jacobs has been absent from practice due to a groin injury.
items.title: Josh Jacobs (groin) could return next week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The NFL has suspended Titans CB Nazeeh Johnson six regular season games for performance-enhancing substance policy violation.
items.impact: Johnson can still participate in all preseason activities. He will be eligible for reinstatement on October 19.
items.title: Nazeeh Johnson suspended six games by NFL

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The NFL has suspended DE Dorance Armstrong Jr. for the season opener.
items.impact: Armstrong is still eligible to participate in all preseason activities. He'll be eligible for reinstatement on September 14.
items.title: Dorance Armstrong Jr. suspended for the season opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bills DT Phidarian Mathis has been suspended for three games for violating the NFL's Substances of Abuse Policy.
items.impact: Mathis is still eligible to participate in preseason practices and games. He'll be eligible to return September 28.
items.title: Phidarian Mathis suspended three games

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles signed LB Brandon George.
items.impact: George spent last season on injured reserve with the Chiefs. He will compete for a depth role in the Eagles linebacker room.
items.title: Brandon George signs with Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Falcons DE James Pearce Jr. is being suspended eight regular-season games for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy.
items.impact: Pearce was arrested in February after a domestic dispute. He will miss the first eight games of the season.
items.title: James Pearce Jr. suspended eight games by NFL

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kurtis Rourke was released from a local hospital Thursday night.
items.impact: Rourke left Thursday's preseason game against the Titans in the first half. He was having trouble breathing, head coach Kyle Shanahan said after the game. The initial X-rays he underwent did not show a broken rib.
items.title: Kurtis Rourke (ribs) released from hospital

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said he has 'no concern' over the rib injury that Carson Beck is dealing with.
items.impact: The injury kept Beck out of Thursday's preseason game against the Raiders. He should be good to go for next week's preseason game.
items.title: Carson Beck not dealing with serious rib injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said "it's his job to lose" when asked about Kirk Cousins' status as QB1 following Thursday's preseason game.
items.impact: Cousins played on the opening drive on Thursday, which resulted in a touchdown pass to Michael Mayer. He remains highly likely to open the season as the starter for Las Vegas.
items.title: Kirk Cousins: Starting job is 'his to lose' per HC Klint Kubiak

title: Fantasy Player News
